purpose: Five verified shared-family outline passes after independent registration audit; final reference/result and start/result wipe page.
registration: Review source-independent silhouette intervals first; change neither poses nor sizing unless coherent independent evidence supports correction. Any changed optical footprint requires fresh path/source work before outline trials.

initial.response: White overlay first; encoded/linear chromatic lift alternatives later
initial.opacity: One equal-reference train-only bounded scalar, no per-reference coefficients

selection: Retain incumbent unless every original paired body/SSIM/foreground/exterior/partial guard passes against both start and incumbent. Development seed is lowest balanced training loss, separately labeled unaccepted. Never waive guards.
trial_limit: At most three substantive settings per pass. Fit one common scalar per setting; train excludes held and all foreground. Save every rejection.
frozen: Working20 body/source/blur/AA2, original cases/masks/foreground, original 16/22 partial cohorts. Outline not part of refraction.
feedback: Wider fade; right weakest upper-right, left weakest lower-left; endpoints tentative. Shared compact/expanded law, only length differs.
page: All five passes, four references, slider comparison with original reference and starting model, side-by-side and fullscreen, desktop/touch/keyboard checks.
